audience: Lindy is for a team that wants an agent in Slack for meetings, the inbox, and scheduled routines, and that will pay per active user. Team starts at $29.99 per active user a month, with 3,000 credits each, pooled across the team. The verdict is the billing unit. Anyone who uses Lindy in the workspace is an active user, including a person who @mentions Lindy in Slack.

It is a poor fit if you wanted a workflow tool with a published price per run, or a free plan that stays free. Free is $0 and starts with $50 in credits. The FAQ says those credits last 7 days. Direct signups are billed right away. Slack joiners get a 7-day free trial.
features: Lindy sits in Slack. The page says it handles meetings, the inbox, and scheduled routines, with 1,500+ integrations and MCP support. You can choose the model per task. Team includes computer use. Prices were checked Oct 17, 2026 (17 October 2026) on https://www.lindy.ai/pricing.

The credit guide on that page splits work into bands. Everyday asks are 2 to 250 credits. Deep work is 250 to 1,000. Big builds are 1,000 to 2,500. A seat includes 3,000 credits a month. Those bands are ranges on the page, not a fixed cost for one meeting.
Team credits are pooled. Top-ups are $10 per 1,000 credits. Enterprise is Custom. The Enterprise card lists HIPAA and BAA, SSO and SCIM, and audit logs.
limitations: Every active user in the workspace is billed. A Slack channel that @mentions Lindy can add a seat. Slack joiners get 7 days free. After that, they are on the bill. Direct signups do not get that trial.
Monthly credits do not roll over. Top-up credits do not expire until used. When credits run out, Lindy pauses. The pause avoids a surprise bill. It also stops the agent if the pool is empty.
The rating is Depends. Depends means the $29.99 price is real, and the workspace can add seats by use, not only by an admin invite. There is no affiliate relationship. Visit goes to lindy.ai.

faqs.a: Free is $0. It starts with $50 in free credits and does not ask for a credit card. The FAQ says those credits last 7 days. Team is from $29.99 per active user a month.

faqs.q: Who counts as an active user?
faqs.a: Every active user in the workspace is billed, including people who @mention Lindy in Slack. Slack joiners get a 7-day free trial. Direct signups are billed right away. Each Team user gets 3,000 credits, pooled across the team.
Monthly credits do not roll over. Top-up credits, at $10 per 1,000, do not expire until used. When credits run out, Lindy pauses. There is no surprise bill.

faqs.a: No. We do not have a tracking URL. Visit goes to lindy.ai.
